attorneys: William C. Sennett, Attorney General of Pennsylvania, Edward Friedman, Counsel General, and Edgar R. Casper, Deputy Attorney General, for appellants. Harvey N. Schmidt for appellees.

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. E. D. Pa. Motion of appellees for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Probable jurisdiction noted and case set for oral argument immediately-following No. 1134, infra. Joint motion to advance granted.
